title: Harness of Minervini v2 ticker.swings response

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

no_cache.description: Bypass both provider-cache reads and writes for this invocation.

limitations: This proposes and decides nothing: no setup state, no signals. Approval is a person reading the chart and declaring the chain back to ticker.setup, which re-runs the same detector rather than trusting what it is handed.

The retracement is the harness's own convention, not the source's, which describes swing reading as chart work and never names a percentage. It is registered as a parameter rather than a threshold, is not a caller input, and is scaled to the stock's own typical daily range rather than fixed: whether a given give-back is noise is a fact about the stock, and a fixed percentage read a quiet name's real contractions and a volatile name's intraday chop as the same event. The multiple, the range it was applied to, and the percentage it came out at all travel with the answer.

The base's left edge is where the stock last broke out of a structure and stayed out -- a close above a prior high, before the pivot formed, on volume above its own preceding fifty sessions, with every low since above that high. Fewer than fifty prior sessions is not that observation, so no boundary is drawn there. That is the source's own buy point, and it is the observation price alone does not supply: on price a rally above an earlier rally top inside a correction and a fresh consolidation under an old peak are the same picture at different magnitudes. A segmentation that neighbouring multiples disagree with is not proposed at all: the disagreement is returned instead. Most real histories come back that way, because real price structure has no single canonical scale, and an unsettled segmentation is the honest answer rather than a defect to tune away.
A move still underway is never confirmed, so the leg the stock is in now is reported apart from the base. Folding it in would put the pivot on the breakout bar.
x-capability-contract.output: The candidate base chain ending on its pivot, the leg price is in now, the sessions a bar could not settle, and the parameters the detector ran at.

status_meanings.ok: A segmentation the detector will vouch for.
status_meanings.partial: Completed price history stops before the requested session.
status_meanings.unavailable: No segmentation this capability will stand behind: the history is unusable as bars at all (missing columns, non-numeric values, a repeated session), neighbouring multiples disagree, a session inside the base both extended and reversed a move, or the history segments into no base. The reason names which. Not needs_input, because the parameters are deliberately out of the caller's reach and no argument would change the answer.

x-capability-contract.summary: Propose the harness's own swing segmentation for a ticker, so a person can look at it before a setup rests on it.
